Class CriteriiUtilizator

java.lang.Object
domain.CriteriiUtilizator
public final class CriteriiUtilizator extends Object
Utility class providing reusable filtering predicates for User entities.

      public static boolean faraPrieteni(User user)
      Evaluates whether a user has no friends registered in the network. Designed to be referenced via static method reference: CriteriiUtilizator::faraPrieteni.
